title: Transduction of i3Neurons Support Protocol
author: Michael S. Fernandopulle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5wvg7e6
materials: Agitate plate to evenly distribute transfection solution.

Optional: Replace medium on HEK cells with 1 mL to 2 mL fresh HEK medium, to be collected the following day. This process can be repeated until Day 6 to collect more virus. Be aware that viral titer decreases with each collection. Lentiviral preps can also be concentrated using various commercially available reagents (e.g., Clontech, cat. no. 631231 ).
Immediately flick the tube several times to mix.

steps.title: Plate Lenti-X HEK Cells
steps.instruction: Plate 2.5 × 10^6 Lenti-X HEK cells in a 6-well dish well in 1.5 mL DMEM/F12 containing 10% FBS (HEK medium).

steps.title: Verify Cell Confluency
steps.instruction: Check cells under an inverted microscope; cells should be > 95% confluent for maximal viral production efficiency. If necessary, wait one day before transfection.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Tubes
steps.instruction: Warm two tubes containing 150 µL Opti-MEM each to room temperature and add reagents as follows:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.6 µg psPAX, 0.6 µg pMD302, 0.2 µg pAdvantage, 2.4 µg pLEX viral vector, and 10 µL P3000 reagent to tube A.
Add 1.87 µL Lipofectamine 3000 to tube B.

steps.title: Incubate Reagents
steps.instruction: Incubate both tubes at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Combine Transfection Mix
steps.instruction: Combine the contents of tube A into tube B using a P200 pipette.

steps.title: Final Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the combined tube at room temperature for 20 to 40 minutes.

steps.title: Transfect Lenti-X Cells
steps.instruction: Add the contents of the tube dropwise to the medium of the Lenti-X cells using a P1000 pipette.

steps.title: Replace Medium
steps.instruction: Replace the medium on Lenti-X HEK cells with 3 mL of warm, fresh HEK medium supplemented with 6 µL of 500× ViralBoost reagent.

steps.title: Verify Viral Production
steps.instruction: Monitor cells using microscopy to confirm successful production.

substeps.instruction: Use a fluorescent microscope to ensure expression of fluorescent proteins in the viral vector.
Use an inverted microscope to check for multinucleated morphology and fluorescent protein production.

steps.title: Collect and Purify Virus
steps.instruction: Collect the medium from the well and remove floating HEK cells and debris.

substeps.instruction: Filter the medium to purify the virus, OR
Centrifuge the medium at 4 °C for 10 minutes (speed not specified), then transfer the supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Store Virus
steps.instruction: Use the purified virus immediately or freeze aliquots at -80 °C.
